usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and Clientary receives records through “Create Client” and “Create Expense”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Client” in Clientary
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who gave contact details becomes a client record you can bill.

watchOut: “Create Expense” in Clientary records an expense, so pair it with “Order Cancelled” in Shopify only if that fits.
